Model coverage, sources & credits

These complementary models cover major visible heart structures; they are not an exhaustive microscopic or surgical atlas. Chordae tendineae, conduction tissue, small vessels, and some septal details are not separately segmented. No synthetic parts have been attached to the reference meshes. Layer thicknesses and separation are schematic.

Heart: Human Reference Atlas / HuBMAP, Visible Human Male heart (CCF release v1.3), based on National Library of Medicine data. Model recoloured and centred; cutaway and separation are viewing effects. Human Reference Atlas · Source model.

Vessels: BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science licensed under CC Attribution 4.0 International. Adapted from the optimised geometry published in Human Atlas: heart-region subset, grouped branches, recolouring and viewing transformations. Dataset licence · CC BY 4.0.

Teaching references: OpenStax — Heart anatomy and NIH / NHLBI — Blood flow. Hausa explanations await qualified educator review. Educational use, not clinical guidance. Three.js is used under its MIT licence.
